<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms, I need the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample. The spectrum will list chemical shift values for each distinct carbon environment. Aromatic carbons typically appear in the 110–160 ppm region. By counting the peaks within this range, I can report the number of aromatic carbons. I will request the carbon NMR spectrum using the provided tool.</thought>
